week.history.header.title.notes: {week_number} = ISO-8601 week number of a Monday-start week (verified on 4 dated examples). Same string is the serif display title on the home screen.

week.history.header.range.evidence: references/auto/retro/press/jeddacp-2024-05-home-profile-journals.png ("Apr 29 – May 5", "Apr 22 – 28", en-US); references/auto/retro/press/engadget-2026-08-profile.jpg ("10–16 Aug", "3–9 Aug", en-AU); store mockups references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-02.png ("Jul 3 - 9", "Jun 26 - Jul 2")
week.history.header.range.notes: Locale-formatted Monday–Sunday interval, month shown once when both ends share it. Real app uses an en dash (spaced in en-US); store mockups use a spaced hyphen. Omitted when the current week has no photos (jedda 2024 "Week 19").

week.history.tile.weekday.notes: Locale 3-letter weekday of the photo. 2023 builds used "Tues"/"Thurs" ({PR23}); 2024+ use 3 letters.

week.history.tile.empty.month.notes: Top line of an empty-day placeholder tile.

week.history.tile.empty.day.notes: Middle line, large bold day number.

week.history.tile.empty.weekday.notes: Bottom line of an empty-day placeholder tile.

week.history.lastWeek.notes: Gray capsule beside the home title while the previous week is still shown early in a new week. Exact trigger not confirmed.

week.history.onThisWeek.subtitle.notes: Small subtitle under the large serif date on the Rewind ("this week in past years") screen.

week.history.onThisWeek.date.notes: Both long-month (marketing) and abbreviated-month (real device, Dec 2025) date styles observed; the real-device style is "Jul 22, 2022".

week.history.menu.hidePhoto.notes: Rewind "•••" menu item (sentence case in source).

week.history.menu.shareToWeek.notes: Rewind "•••" menu item; in a group product the target noun may need adapting (record substitution if so).

week.history.empty.label.notes: Gray label of the profile onboarding card shown above the week list while history is short.

week.history.empty.body.text: {app_name} is a weekly photo album. Try adding photos to 3 different weeks below.
week.history.empty.body.evidence: references/auto/retro/press/engadget-2026-08-profile.jpg ("Retro is a weekly photo album. Try adding photos to 3 different weeks below.")
week.history.empty.body.notes: Substitution: app name "Retro" -> {app_name}. The accompanying progress ring ("2") is a count/gamification element: do not copy.
